attempt_summaries.rationale: Fixed findings: set automountServiceAccountToken false, changed container to runAsNonRoot with non-zero user, set allowPrivilegeEscalation false and readOnlyRootFilesystem true, added CPU/memory limits/requests, pinned image tag to v1.2.3.
Moved automountServiceAccountToken from securityContext to pod spec level to satisfy schema and keep it false.

final_yaml:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: ledger-api
  namespace: finance
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: ledger-api
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: ledger-api
    spec:
      hostAliases:
        - ip: "10.0.5.20"
          hostnames: ["legacy-db.corp.internal"]
      dnsPolicy: "None"
      dnsConfig:
        nameservers: ["10.0.0.10"]
        searches: ["corp.internal"]
        options:
          - name: ndots
            value: "1"
      securityContext:
        sysctls:
          - name: net.ipv4.ip_local_port_range
            value: "1024 65000"
      automountServiceAccountToken: false
      containers:
        - name: api
          image: registry.example.com/ledger-api:v1.2.3
          env:
            - name: DB_HOST
              value: legacy-db.corp.internal
          ports:
            - containerPort: 8443
          securityContext:
            runAsNonRoot: true
            runAsUser: 1000
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "256Mi"
            requests:
              cpu: "250m"
              memory: "128Mi"
